docs.syncHttpHowItWorksTitle: How sync + HTTP works on this page
docs.syncHttpHowItWorksLine1: HTTP sync trigger calls /sync/... and the server broadcasts through Socket.io to users in the same room.
docs.postmanLine1: Use Cookie auth header: token=YOUR_SESSION_TOKEN, or keep Postman cookie jar enabled after login.
docs.postmanLine2: Set language header with Accept-Language (preferred) or X-Language (also supported).
docs.postmanLine3: API URL format: /api/{page}/{name}/{version} and Sync URL format: /sync/{page}/{name}/{version}.
docs.httpGuideLine1: Use HTTP for one-time API calls or to trigger a sync broadcast from backend routes.
docs.httpGuideLine2: For protected routes, authenticate first so your browser cookie or token is included.
docs.httpGuideLine3: Set header Accept-Language to control localized error messages.
docs.socketGuideLine1: Use Socket mode for real-time callback responses and room-based broadcasts.
docs.socketGuideLine2: Join a room before testing broadcasts so you can receive the emitted sync event.
docs.socketGuideLine4: Use ignoreSelf when you want to broadcast to everyone except your current client.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Plain-language definitions of the terms used across the app.
glossary.workspaceDef: Your project's home — holds its tickets, content, settings and team. You can have several.
glossary.moduleDef: A feature lane you enable per workspace: Development (code), Content & Marketing (media), or Design.
glossary.ticketDef: A unit of work (a task, bug or feature). An AI agent picks it up and moves it through the pipeline.
glossary.pipelineDef: The ordered stages a ticket flows through — e.g. refine, plan, implement, test, review.
glossary.stageDef: One column of the pipeline. Each stage has its own AI prompt, tools and definition-of-done.
glossary.mrDef: A proposed code change awaiting review and approval before it merges into your main branch.
glossary.environmentDef: A running deployment of your app at a stable URL (dev, staging, prod or demo).
glossary.pieceDef: One media project — a script, voiceover, images and the rendered video, in the Content module.
glossary.shortlinkDef: A /l/slug link that counts clicks — the conversion signal for an ad or campaign.

designer.themesSub: Pick one to preview — or make your own.
designer.aiSoon: AI theme generation — coming in the next update
designer.aiPlaceholder: Describe the look — e.g. 'a warm, premium fintech theme' or 'playful mint & coral'
designer.aiError: Couldn't generate a theme. Try again.
designer.noneActive: Nothing active — the coding agent has no design system yet

sec.buttonsSub: Primary actions, variants and icon buttons.
sec.selectsSub: Single- and multi-select, with sizes and search.
sec.inputsSub: Text, number, password, toggles, checkboxes and dates.
sec.dataSub: Status pills, labels, avatars and empty states.
sec.statesSub: Interactive states: focus, loading, disabled and error.
sec.tokensSub: Every design token in this theme.

designer.confirmDemoBody: This is just a demo — nothing will actually be deleted.
designer.infoDotBody: A small hint that reveals more on hover.
designer.emptyDemoSub: This is how an empty state looks in the current theme.
designer.notHex: Not a plain hex — edit the text field directly.
designer.tagline: See, compare and edit every part of your product's visual language.
designer.themesEditSub: Edit the 30 colour tokens; contrast is graded live.
designer.exportBody: Copied to your clipboard. Paste this into src/index.css to make it the app theme.
designer.deriveHint: Auto-compute the hover + border shades of the accent from its base colour.
designer.previewCardBody: A short line of body copy to check readability.
designer.stylesSub: Design skills — the shape, elevation and feel around your colours.
designer.styleShowcase: Live showcase — switch or edit the style to reshape these.
designer.styleCardBody: Everything your team needs, in one calm place.
designer.animationsSub: Motion presets — preview, tune and reuse.
designer.springNote: Springs are physics-based — tune bounce + duration and watch the preview.
designer.reducedMotionNote: Respects the system “reduce motion” setting automatically.
designer.typographySub: The heading + body pairing of the active style, across a full scale.
designer.typeSample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
designer.typeParagraph: Good typography is invisible: it carries the content without calling attention to itself. This paragraph checks line length, rhythm and colour contrast in the body font of the current style.

interviewer.title: Interviewer
interviewer.generateStarted: Generating improvement ideas — they'll appear here when ready.
interviewer.intro: Ask anything about this codebase and think through new plans together. It has repo context, so ask how something works, what's worth improving, or to work out a plan.
interviewer.startersTitle: Try one of these to start:

starter.explain: Explain how the authentication flow works in this codebase.
starter.improve: What are the top things worth improving in this project?
starter.plan: Work out a plan for adding a new feature — ask me what it is first.
starter.risks: What are the biggest risks or fragile areas in this codebase?

interviewer.placeholder: Ask about your codebase, or describe a plan…
interviewer.error: Something went wrong reaching the AI. Try again.

scheduledPosts.title: Scheduled posts
scheduledPosts.tagline: Publishes queued to go out at a set time.
scheduledPosts.empty: No scheduled posts yet. Schedule a publish from a content piece to see it here.

scheduled.title: Scheduled tasks
scheduled.tagline: Run an AI role or a notification on a schedule.
scheduled.empty: No scheduled tasks yet. Create one to run something on a cron schedule.
scheduled.name: Name
scheduled.focusPlaceholder: e.g. the auth flow, or leave blank for the whole project

automation.title: Automation
automation.subtitle: Fire an action when something happens, or on a schedule.
automation.empty: No triggers yet. Create one to automate notifications, stage moves, and more.
automation.commandHelp: Runs in the ticket's workspace container. Always asks for approval before running.
automation.aiPromptPlaceholder: Summarise the open tickets and suggest priorities
automation.signalKindHelp: A signal is a named event other triggers or stages can wait for.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: AI-drafted workspace documents: specs, plans, briefs and sheets — you approve every AI change.

inspire.title: Inspiration
inspire.desc: Import a look you love: paste a site URL (we screenshot + extract its style into a theme proposal), upload a screenshot, or compare your page against an inspiration - the analysis lands in the review inbox.
inspire.done: Done - check your theme library / review inbox.
inspire.failed: Failed - is the vision AI configured and the URL reachable?
